review.brief: Validate RM4-account-persist-vehicle-access-type (tier 2). (1) Boundary: only internal/account touched; no import of internal/tesla; no other-module edits. (2) DB design MATCHES the user-confirmed design (RD2/RD3, design.md D1-D3): migration is nullable access_type TEXT + CHECK(IS NULL OR IN('OWNER','DRIVER')), NO index, NO DEFAULT; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING UNCHANGED (no backfill/re-seed added) - any mismatch is a BLOCKER finding. (3) go-conventions persistence: goose migration is the single sqlc schema source; pgtype.Text confined to service.go boundary helpers + generated accountdb, never in public types; AccessType is *string on Vehicle/OwnedVehicle/SeedVehicle. (4) sqlc regen correct: InsertVehicleIfMissingParams / accountdb.Vehicle / ListAllVehiclesRow gained AccessType pgtype.Text; ListVehiclesByAccount selects it. (5) Spec coverage: specs/account-vehicle-registry delta scenarios (seed-with persists+returns; seed-without=NULL; reads surface it; CHECK rejects invalid) match impl + tests. (6) Tests: DATABASE_URL-gated self-skip; cover OWNER/DRIVER/nil round-trip, re-seed idempotency (stored value unchanged), invalid-value CHECK rejection. (7) Performance-Profile read-heavy: no-index justified (never a predicate). (8) Service interface signatures UNCHANGED (backward-compatible). (9) Anti-gaming: tasks.md checkboxes + progress.json statuses truthful; no weakened criteria. Read the diff (commit 48d78cb) + the 4 artifacts, not the whole module. Escalate on any doubt.
